title: MediSync Scheduling Assistant
shortDescription: A voice and messaging assistant that handles appointment booking, rescheduling and reminders for a multi-site clinic group.
fullDescription: Reception teams across several clinics spent most of their day on the phone rearranging appointments. MediSync answers those calls, confirms identity against the practice system, offers genuinely available slots and books them — while routing anything clinical straight to a person. Reminder and waitlist handling run automatically, which measurably reduced empty chairs.

features.title: Identity verification
features.description: Callers confirmed against the practice system before any appointment detail is discussed.

features.title: Real availability
features.description: Slots are read live and provisionally held during the call, never offered speculatively.

features.title: Strict clinical boundary
features.description: Any clinical question is transferred immediately; the assistant handles scheduling only.

features.title: Automated reminders
features.description: Voice and SMS reminders with one-step confirm, reschedule or cancel.

features.title: Waitlist backfill
features.description: Cancellations trigger outbound offers to the waitlist in priority order.

features.title: Multi-site routing
features.description: Location, clinician and service rules applied per site from one configuration.

challenge.summary: Reception was saturated by scheduling calls, and late cancellations left slots empty because nobody had time to work the waitlist.

points.title: Reception overwhelmed
points.description: Call volume peaked far beyond what reception could answer, so patients waited or gave up.

points.title: Unfilled late cancellations
points.description: Late cancellations frequently went unfilled, wasting clinician time.

points.title: Manual reminder calls
points.description: Reminder calls were made manually and inconsistently.

points.title: No clinical advice, ever
points.description: Any automated system had to be unambiguous about not giving clinical advice.

solution.summary: We scoped the assistant tightly to scheduling, integrated directly with the practice management system, and made escalation immediate on anything clinical.

points.title: Scheduling-only intents

points.title: Live availability, always real

points.title: No double-booking

points.title: Automated reminders
points.description: Automated reminders across voice and SMS with single-step responses.

points.title: Waitlist backfill

objectives: Answer appointment calls beyond reception capacity
Fill slots released by late cancellations
Remind every patient reliably, on voice and SMS
Never give clinical advice through the assistant
Keep availability and bookings in sync with the practice system
clientOverview: A multi-site clinic group whose phone lines peaked far beyond what reception could answer. Patients waited on hold or gave up, late cancellations left clinician time unfilled, and reminder calls were made by hand, inconsistently. Any automation had to stay strictly within scheduling — clinical topics had to bounce to a person immediately.
conclusion: Patients now book, reschedule and confirm appointments through a voice and messaging assistant that shares the practice's real availability, holds slots to prevent double-booking, and hands every clinical question straight to a person. Reminders go out automatically on voice and SMS, and released slots are backfilled by a waitlist that dials candidates the moment a slot opens.
